description:
Saves the forward authentication settings; send only what changes. Fields set by environment variables are ignored. An upstream is empty (none) or scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name without a path, otherwise the answer is 400. The settings decide who can sign in to protected hosts, so a session is required and an API token gets 403. The change reloads nginx and is applied before it is saved: when applying fails, nothing is saved.
Needs: a signed-in session (API tokens are refused). Administrators only

requestBody.description: The settings to change; fields you leave out keep their value

anubis_upstream.description: Default Anubis upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

tinyauth_upstream.description: Default Tinyauth upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

oauth2proxy_upstream.description: Default OAuth2 Proxy upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

voidauth_upstream.description: Default VoidAuth upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

authelia_upstream.description: Default Authelia upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

authentik_upstream.description: Default Authentik upstream for proxy hosts without their own: scheme://host:port or scheme://cu_name, no path; empty = none (env AUTH_REQUEST_*_UPSTREAM)

anubis_custom_images.description: Use the custom Anubis images from /data/public/anubis (env AUTH_REQUEST_ANUBIS_USE_CUSTOM_IMAGES)

200.description: The forward authentication settings after the save, in the same form as the GET answer

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot be used for this request`.
